ASSAY-DEFECT repair of the DEV-CAL-2 draw-invariance check (PR #343 terminal ASSAY_DEFECT; issue #323 assay-repair lane). DEFECT: arm KO-1_REPRESENTATION failed draw-invariance (per-seed cell-B mean reductions -0.3958/+0.0134/-0.2381 disagree in sign). ONE-STAGE ATTRIBUTION (checker registration, not adapter, not system): the V1 draw-invariance rule applied ZERO-TOLERANCE sign agreement to per-seed means at per-seed n=30 (capped by the frozen 30-world cell-B matrix; seeds 0-2 frozen), which is underpowered for arms whose true effect is null/near-null BY DESIGN (the freeze expects KO-1 silent). Evidence on the committed V1 receipts: (i) INSTRUMENT EXCLUDED -- KO-1's keying is draw-independent: keying_rule=SURFACE_SIGNATURE_V1 with retrieval_key_match=False on all 90 cell-B rows in all three seeds (keyed-object set empty per seed, semantically equal), retrieval ledger exactly 7 and adaptation 0 on every row; per-pair work(KO-1)-work(RESET) = 7 + blind-rank noise (range -11352..+12666, mean -73.7) -- no draw-dependent content enters the knockout. (ii) ESTIMATOR DEFECT CONFIRMED -- every KO-1 seed mean sits INSIDE its own 95% sign-flip null band at n=30 (-0.396 vs 0.41, +0.013 vs 0.16, -0.238 vs 0.32), so its direction is statistically indeterminate in all three seeds; simulation on the V1 per-pair reductions puts the V1 rule's false-ASSAY_DEFECT rate under a true-zero effect at 25.6% (KO-1 distribution), 9.8% (LOO-MINUS-REPRESENTATION), 44.4% (LOO-MINUS-RETRIEVAL) over 2000 bootstrap pseudo-runs. (iii) SYSTEM EXCLUDED -- recovering arms are direction-DETERMINATE and agree in all seeds (+0.968/+0.971/+0.971 etc.), anchors reproduce committed DEVCAL1 values, machinery is deterministic per (arm,world,seed). Process root: devcal2_sanity class 15 validated the check only on a ~96%-effect arm, so the near-null misfire class was invisible pre-run. FIX (pre-registered, authored BEFORE any re-run verdict): draw_invariance re-registered as NULL_BAND_GATED_V1 -- per seed, direction is evidence-bearing only when the seed mean lies OUTSIDE its own 95% sign-flip null band (same PERM_N sign-flip discipline, deterministic tag seed); draw-invariance fails only when two determinate seeds DISAGREE; an all-indeterminate arm is classified NULL_EFFECT (an absence is draw-invariant -- recorded, never a defect). Since per-seed n cannot be raised within the frozen matrix, adequacy is registered as the null band at n=30; the re-registered rule's false-fire rate under true-zero is 0.25-0.50% (same simulations). UNCHANGED BY THIS AMENDMENT: recovery thresholds (0.25), the 20% effect threshold, terminal set and precedence, world matrix, seeds, anchors, adapters (adapter records byte-identical -- adapters are data), carrier/ladder logic; the re-registered rule can only remove a statistically-unfounded defect and cannot create carrier evidence (it is strictly harder for a real effect to flip direction unnoticed, and the sanity suite now plants both the near-null straddle (must stay non-defective) and a determinate per-seed direction conflict (must defect)). Sanity selftest with the two new class-15 regression hostiles: PASS exit 0. Re-run executed at the fix commit bound below on laptop billy; V1 evidence (PR #343 shards, DEVCAL2_RESULTS.json, host receipt) preserved byte-identical; V2 artifacts land under new _V2 names and are bound in this amendment's manifest.
